records.native_title: Love the product, hate the packaging
records.native_body: I do actually love this product across the board. The problem is with the packaging. The lid keeps coming unscrewed and tonight it came loose in my pocket at work so it seeped onto my brand new underwear, and also onto my work shirt and of course there’s now a spot on my jeans. Worse, once I collected all the loose product onto my pinkie I had no way to put it back into the package. I hate complaining about packaging because that’s not made in house. That’s ordered from a manufacturer, so. I don’t know if maybe it should do a whole click lock when you screw the cap on, or if a doe foot option might be worth it? I just hate that because void is my favorite I’ve lost a lot of it to the lid coming off so I will repurchase. I love it so so much, but I’m very annoyed to lose so much product when it’s not that cheap.

answer.report:
Initial-stage diagnosis: packaging receives repeated favorable comments from distinct visible TikTok accounts in one brand-owned video thread. P00’s metal-packaging praise has 296 displayed likes, supporting audience resonance with that statement, not verified environmental performance or 296 customer experiences. P38 and P40 separately praise appearance; P21 and P39 approve the packaging more generally. P26 also calls it great but questions skin benefits. These support recurring packaging approval within this thread, not cross-venue corroboration, representative reception or product efficacy. The packaging SKU/version is not established by the supplied video comments; the product catalog cannot supply that attribution.

Environmental claims remain unresolved. P01 is the brand agreeing with P00, not independent customer corroboration. P03 is P00’s same author elaborating with qualified recycling/reuse assumptions, not another origin or verified materials evidence. P02 questions environmental friendliness and recyclability without establishing the opposite. P15’s proposed empty-container reuse has 150 likes: substantial visible resonance with a reuse intention, not completed reuse or evidence of suitability. P42 reports receipt and newly discovering refillability; that supports one recipient’s reported awareness gap, without proving the whole packaging system’s environmental impact.

Failure and remedy: P06 alone reports arrival leakage with a loose top, opening and cleaning the product, and concern about oxygen exposure. The complaint SKU/version is unknown. This is one detailed customer report, with 12 likes; those likes do not independently corroborate leakage, its mechanism or prevalence. P07, the brand reply with 12 likes, says short exposure is not an issue and offers a replacement if contacted. This establishes the offer and brand reassurance, not independent safety verification, a replacement sent or delivered, or a resolved complaint. No other focal account reports leakage, explicitly describes a loose top, or gives bare arrival-leak agreement. No retailer evidence is supplied. Favorable appearance comments and this functional complaint can coexist; overall reception is mixed across attributes, without establishing opposing experiences of the same leakage proposition.

Buying and loyalty: P17 explicitly reports an all-Experiment routine and Continuum in the mail, alongside newfound brand loyalty; packaging is not identified as the reason. P20’s sweeping buying declaration does not establish completed checkout. P32 conditionally considers saving up; P38 anticipates trying; neither establishes purchase. P42 explicitly reports receipt, without an acquisition motive. P04 requests refill bundles, while P27 specifically requests a Continuum/Super Saturated refill bundle; requests are not orders or explicit repeat-purchase commitments. P29 asks about a sticker in their refill, without narrating checkout. No explicit repurchase intention, return, abandonment or packaging-driven completed purchase appears. P06 does not state disloyalty; P17’s loyalty belongs to a different actor and cannot be assigned to the complainant.
